status: NONCANONICAL SANDBOX. Every value tagged sandbox_proposal needs owner approval before any canonical use. Values tagged sheet are copied from api_bridge/gm/aero_character_runtime.yml (or SRD core actions) and change nothing there.

ruleset.opt_in: sandbox fixtures only; turn-contract/3 and every campaign are unchanged

secondary_action.note: SA-001 Secondary budget. Off = legacy: Secondary budget 0 and every Secondary profile is refused (SA001_DISABLED).

battle_insight_bonus.note: Battle Insight as a Bonus action instead of Main. Level 0 is not itself a Bonus authorization.

force_augmentation.note: Spend 1 Force Point to add 1d4 to one learned strike's attack roll; once per turn.

ranged_in_melee_disadvantage.text: Disadvantage on ranged attacks while a visible enemy is within 5 ft. A common d20 rule, but not on Aero's sheet; off until the owner approves it.

provenance.source: common d20 convention (ranged attack with a hostile within 5 ft); NOT on Aero's runtime sheet
provenance.approval: owner 2026-11-22: approved for opt-in sandbox testing only; not globally promoted
provenance.rule: Disadvantage on a ranged attack roll while a hostile creature within 5 ft of the attacker can see it and is not incapacitated.
exceptions: hostile is hidden (not perceiving the attacker in this model)
the attacker is hidden from it
grappled or prone hostiles STILL count (not incapacitated)

ruleset.reaction_note: One ordinary Reaction per round. A Riposte can never trigger another Riposte (trigger fence); a spent Reaction stays spent.

prone.rules: Melee attacks against a prone creature have advantage. A prone creature attacks with disadvantage. It stands at the start of its own turn, spending 15 ft of movement.

saber_strike.name: Lightsaber Strike
saber_strike.rules: Melee weapon attack +5 vs AC. Hit: 1d8+3 energy (one-handed).

unarmed_strike.name: Echani Strike
unarmed_strike.rules: Melee unarmed attack +5 vs AC. Hit: 1d4+3 kinetic. Needs no free hand.
unarmed_strike.source: aero_character_runtime.yml Martial Arts Training / unarmed strike

flow_strike.name: Echani Flow Strike
flow_strike.rules: After a melee attack this turn: one unarmed follow-up, +5 to hit, 1d4 kinetic (no Dexterity to damage).

feint.name: Weapon Feint

effect.note: Advantage on your next melee attack against that target this turn. Lost if the target leaves your reach first.

feint.rules: Contest: your Charisma (Deception) vs its Wisdom (Insight). Win: advantage on your next melee attack against it this turn. Lose: it read you; nothing else. Never an automatic hit.
feint.source: Draft power_feinting_attack (superiority-dice based; not used) reworked per CC-002 §2

parry.name: Parry
parry.rules: Reaction when a melee attack would hit you while your blade is lit: +2 AC against that attack (it may miss instead).
parry.source: Draft parry uses superiority die + Dex (Aero has no superiority dice); proficiency-bonus redirect proposed instead

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.rules: Reaction when a melee attack against you misses: one lightsaber strike against the attacker. Uses your Reaction. A Riposte can never trigger another Riposte.
riposte.source: Draft power_riposte (reaction after a missed melee attack)

readied_dodge.name: Readied Dodge

effect.note: Until your next turn you may spend your Reaction to impose disadvantage on one attack roll against you.

readied_dodge.rules: Secondary: get ready. Later, Reaction when attacked: that attack roll has disadvantage. Still one Reaction per round.
readied_dodge.source: CC-002 §2 Readied Dodge (Novice tier). Dodge percentages 50/66.7/83.3/98% are NOT used.

dodge_reaction.name: Dodge (readied)
dodge_reaction.rules: Spend your Reaction: the attack against you has disadvantage.

dodge_action.name: Dodge Action

effect.note: Attacks against you have disadvantage until your next turn.

dodge_action.rules: Core action: until your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage.

blade_bind.name: Blade Bind & Strip

effect.note: Its weapon lands 10 ft away. A hit is not needed; damage is not dealt.

blade_bind.rules: Contest: your Dexterity (Acrobatics) vs its better of Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). Win: its held weapon is stripped and lands 10 ft away. No damage.
blade_bind.source: Draft power_disarming_blow (superiority die) reworked; CC-002 §4 Blade Bind

battle_insight.name: Battle Insight

effect.note: Advantage on your next attack against it (concentration, 1 minute). Does not stack with Feint advantage.

battle_insight.rules: Main action, 0 Force Points: one visible creature within 30 ft. Advantage on your next attack against it.

battle_insight_bonus.name: Battle Insight (quick)
battle_insight_bonus.rules: Bonus-action Battle Insight (switch battle_insight_bonus; off by default).

taunt.name: Taunt

effect.note: Disadvantage on its attacks against anyone but you until your next turn. It still chooses what it does.

taunt.rules: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (switch tb4_taunt): Charisma (Intimidation) vs Wisdom (Insight); ties go to the target.

tactical_glance.name: Tactical Glance
tactical_glance.rules: Secondary: Wisdom (Perception) +4 against anything hiding nearby. Once per turn; no rerolls.

calm_beast.name: Calm the Animal (untrained)

effect.note: It hesitates: disadvantage on its next attack.

calm_beast.rules: Untrained Wisdom (Animal Handling) +2. Aero has no Animal Handling training; dueling training does not grant it.

move.name: Move
move.rules: Close to 5 ft of a target, or withdraw. Leaving an enemy's reach lets it make an opportunity attack with its Reaction.

speak.name: Speak
speak.rules: Brief speech is free. Insults are just words: no debuff unless you use Taunt.

force_augment.name: Force-Guided Strike
force_augment.rules: Spend 1 Force Point when declaring a lightsaber strike or Riposte: +1d4 to that attack roll. Once per turn. Grants no new power.

npc_parry.name: Parry
npc_parry.source: fixture NPC (same profile shape as Aero's)

pounce.name: Pounce from hiding
pounce.rules: From hiding: leap up to 20 ft and bite with advantage. Reveals it.

npc_bind.name: Bind & Wrench
npc_bind.rules: Same contest as Blade Bind & Strip, with a vibroblade.

recover_weapon.name: Recover Weapon
recover_weapon.rules: Move to your dropped weapon (10 ft) and pick it up. A lightsaber comes back unlit.

toggle_blade.name: Ignite / Deactivate
toggle_blade.rules: Ignite or switch off your lightsaber (one object interaction).

controlled_takedown.name: Blade Bind & Takedown

effect.note: Its weapon lands 10 ft away and it is knocked prone. Melee attacks against a prone creature have advantage; it attacks with disadvantage until it stands (15 ft of its movement at the start of its turn).

controlled_takedown.rules: Compound maneuver: 1 Main + 1 Secondary. One contest: your Dexterity (Acrobatics) vs its better of Athletics or Acrobatics. Win: disarmed AND prone. Lose: both actions are spent and nothing happens. No damage.
controlled_takedown.source: CC-003 proposal: Blade Bind & Strip (main) plus a sweep paid for with the Secondary Action (SA-001)

saber_strike_2h.name: Lightsaber Strike (two-handed)
saber_strike_2h.rules: Melee weapon attack +5 vs AC using both hands. Hit: 1d10+3 energy (versatile). Needs your off hand free: not holding the blaster and not grappling.

blaster_shot.name: Blaster Pistol Shot
blaster_shot.rules: Ranged weapon attack +5 vs AC, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1d6+3 energy. Disadvantage beyond 40 ft (sheet). Uses 1 shot (capacity 12). Firing with an enemy adjacent has no penalty unless the 'ranged in melee' sandbox switch is on.
blaster_shot.source: aero_character_runtime.yml weapons: Standard Blaster Pistol (+5, 1d6+3, 40/160, capacity 12, reload: action)

draw_sidearm.name: Draw Blaster
draw_sidearm.rules: Object interaction: draw the blaster pistol from the right hip into your left hand. Your off hand is then occupied (no two-handed grip, no grapple).
draw_sidearm.source: aero_character_runtime.yml carry: right hip for left-hand draw; preferred_blaster_hand: left

holster_sidearm.name: Holster Blaster
holster_sidearm.rules: Object interaction: holster the blaster, freeing your off hand.

reload_sidearm.name: Reload Blaster
reload_sidearm.rules: Main action: refill the pistol to 12 from your reserve (50 shots total).

burst.name: Burst
burst.rules: Main action, 0 FP. Every other creature within 5 ft of you (allies too) makes a DEX save, DC 12. Fail: 1d4 force damage and knocked prone. Success: nothing.
burst.source: aero_character_runtime.yml powers: Burst (level 0, action, 0 FP, 5-ft radius; save, self-exclusion and prone rider are adopted table rulings)

grapple.name: Echani Grapple

effect.note: Its speed becomes 0 while you hold it. No damage, no advantage by itself. Moving away releases it.

grapple.rules: Special melee attack (uses your Main action here): with a free hand, a +5 martial check against its better of Athletics or Acrobatics. Success: grappled, speed 0. Deals no damage.
grapple.source: aero_character_runtime.yml features: Echani Grappling Training (+5 vs Athletics/Acrobatics, free hand, no damage)

lightsaber_deflect.name: Lightsaber Deflect (Tier 1)
lightsaber_deflect.rules: Reaction when a ranged energy attack hits you while your blade is lit: reduce the damage by 1d10+2. If that reduces it to 0, you may redirect the bolt at one visible creature you choose within 30 ft (+5); a hit deals the original rolled damage.
lightsaber_deflect.source: aero_character_runtime.yml features: Lightsaber Deflect - Tier 1 (redirect target: player-chosen visible creature within 30 ft, per the sheet; corrected in CC-005)

force_connection.name: Force Connection (focused)

effect.note: Advantage on one Insight check to read it before the end of your next turn. No combat roll in this sandbox uses Insight, and Combat Discipline already gives Aero advantage on combat Insight, so this has no mechanical effect here.

force_connection.rules: Main action: focus on one visible creature within 30 ft; advantage on one Insight check to read its emotional state or concealment. Cannot read thoughts or statistics.
force_connection.source: aero_character_runtime.yml features: Force Connection (focused, action, 30 ft)

sentinel_balance.name: Sentinel Balance
sentinel_balance.rules: Reaction after you fail a DEX or CHA save: add 1d4, possibly turning it into a success. 2 uses per long rest.
sentinel_balance.inert_note: Nothing in these three encounters forces Aero to make a DEX or CHA save, so it never triggers here.

provenance.note: Sandbox fixture values for the relay droid; not canon.
Sandbox fixture values for the relay droid; not canon.

minor_telekinesis.name: Minor Telekinesis (Jedi Fundamentals)
minor_telekinesis.rules: Gently lift, reposition, retrieve or manipulate one visible, unattended object of 10 lb or less within 30 ft. No Force Points. Outside combat, no roll unless the outcome is uncertain; in combat it uses your action. It cannot deal damage, move or disarm a creature, take anything held or worn, stop a projectile, or stand in for a Force power you have not learned. It is not Force Push or Force Pull. In this sandbox the loose objects are dropped weapons: retrieve your own, or send someone else's dropped weapon 30 ft away (they then need 30 ft of movement to recover it).
minor_telekinesis.source: campaigns/starwars_litrpg/creator/jedi_fundamentals.json (owner ruling 2026-11-11, approved_provisional); campaign starwars_litrpg only; not a Force power
never: substituting for an unlearned combat Force power
minor_telekinesis.sandbox_adaptation: Repositioning a dropped weapon has a positional consequence only (30 ft of movement to recover). Genesis adaptation, pending owner review.

forms._status: Lore traditions are listed for compatibility only; none grants a mechanical bonus in this slice. Source-authored rules: none imported. Genesis proposals: marked per technique.

makashi.name: Form II: Makashi
makashi.lore: Precision dueling; footwork and blade control.

shien_djem_so.name: Form V: Shien / Djem So
shien_djem_so.lore: Power counters; Shien favors blaster redirection.

niman.name: Form VI: Niman
niman.lore: Balanced form blending earlier forms with Force use.

trakata.name: Tràkata
trakata.lore: Switching the blade off and on mid-fight.
trakata.gate: requires blade deactivation timing rules (not authored)

pistol_cqb.name: Pistol CQB
pistol_cqb.gate: ranged profiles not authored in this slice

synergies.name: Echani Flow Line
links: A won feint gives the lightsaber strike advantage (feint profile).
The melee attack unlocks Echani Flow Strike (after_melee_attack_this_turn).
basis: engine hasAdv: feinted → advantage on next melee attack
synergies.conditional: The advantage exists only if the feint wins its contest. Flow Strike is unlocked by the strike being made, hit or miss, and rolls normally.

synergies.name: Opening Cut
links: A won feint gives the lightsaber strike advantage.
synergies.conditional: Only if the feint wins its contest.

synergies.name: Opening Strike
links: A won feint gives the unarmed strike advantage.
synergies.conditional: Only if the feint wins its contest.

synergies.name: Blade and Body
links: The lightsaber strike unlocks Echani Flow Strike.
synergies.conditional: Two separate attack rolls; neither guarantees the other. Needs the lit blade in hand.

synergies.name: Unarmed Flow
links: The unarmed strike unlocks Echani Flow Strike.
synergies.conditional: Two separate attack rolls. A descriptive name only; Soul may propose a better one.

synergies.name: Read and Strike
links: Battle Insight gives advantage on your next attack against that target.
synergies.conditional: Automatic once Battle Insight resolves; the attack still rolls.
